panels.title: Internet
panels.description: Pings Cloudflare every 15 seconds from kejim.

panels.title: Photos
panels.description: HTTPS check of the Photos service, through Traefik, every 15 seconds.

panels.title: Last backup
panels.description: Time since the last successful offsite backup to Backblaze. Runs daily at 5am Central; amber after 26 hours, red after 36.

panels.title: Pool
panels.description: State of the tank mirror on byss.

panels.title: Pool free
panels.description: Free space on tank. Amber below about 20%, red below about 10%.

panels.title: Disks
panels.description: SMART health, worst disk across every machine.

panels.title: Failed units
panels.description: systemd units in a failed state, fleet-wide. Explore node_systemd_unit_state to see which.

panels.title: Certificate
panels.description: Time until the wildcard certificate expires. Traefik renews it about 30 days out, so this should never go amber.

panels.title: Reachability
panels.description: Pings to the house router and Cloudflare, and HTTPS checks of each service, every 15 seconds. Healthy stays quiet; red is an outage.

panels.title: Latency
panels.description: Round trip to Cloudflare. Spikes here with the router still answering point at the ISP, not the house.

panels.title: Download
panels.description: Hourly Ookla speedtest from kejim.

panels.title: Upload
panels.description: Hourly Ookla speedtest from kejim. On its own chart because it is a fraction of download and would flatten on a shared axis.

panels.title: Last reboot
panels.description: Age of the youngest boot among the core nodes.

panels.title: Updates pending
panels.description: Packages apt could upgrade, fleet-wide, from the apt collector's hourly check. The Fleet table says which node.

panels.title: Reboots required
panels.description: Nodes holding a kernel or library update that waits on a reboot.

panels.title: Bays up
panels.description: Project VMs answering their scrape. Off between drills is normal, which is why they are not on the Nodes panel.

panels.title: Nodes
panels.description: Whether Prometheus could scrape each node of the core cluster, every 15 seconds. Red is a node it cannot reach, and the charts below go blank for the same span.

panels.title: Fleet
panels.description: What each node runs and whether it wants attention. Updates and reboot flags come from the apt collector.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: Busy share of all cores, averaged over five minutes.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Memory in use. Excludes ZFS's cache on byss, which the kernel hands back under pressure.

panels.title: Temperature
panels.description: Hottest sensor on each machine. On byss that is usually the GPU.

panels.title: Network
panels.description: Traffic on each node's real interfaces, five-minute rate. Inbound above the line, outbound below.

panels.title: Disk I/O
panels.description: Whole-disk throughput, five-minute rate. Reads above the line, writes below.

panels.title: Disk used
panels.description: Root filesystem on each machine, and the photo library. Amber at 80%, red at 90%.

panels.title: Photo library
panels.description: Size of the Immich library on tank/photos. Expect a steep climb during the Takeout import.

panels.title: Last scrub
panels.description: Time since the pool last finished a scrub. zfsutils scrubs on the second Sunday of each month; amber past 36 days, red past 50.

panels.title: Scrub errors
panels.description: Errors the last scrub found. Any number here is a disk conversation.

panels.title: Drives
panels.description: Every drive the SMART and NVMe collectors can see. Healthy is SMART's verdict for SATA and no critical warning for NVMe; Reallocated is SATA wear, Worn is NVMe wear.

targets.expr: max by (instance, disk) (label_replace(smartmon_device_smart_healthy, "disk", "$1", "disk", "/dev/(.*)") or label_replace(nvme_critical_warning == bool 0, "disk", "$1", "device", "(?:/dev/)?(nvme[0-9]+)n[0-9]+"))

max by (instance, disk) (label_replace(smartmon_temperature_celsius_raw_value or smartmon_airflow_temperature_cel_raw_value, "disk", "$1", "disk", "/dev/(.*)") or label_replace(nvme_temperature_celsius, "disk", "$1", "device", "(?:/dev/)?(nvme[0-9]+)n[0-9]+"))
